content: To count SVG child elements inside widget containers using JS in chromote: eval_js_value(session, 'document.querySelectorAll(".gg2d3.html-widget").length') counts widget divs. To get per-widget child counts: 'Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".gg2d3.html-widget svg")).map(svg => svg.querySelectorAll("path, circle, rect, line, g").length)'. For blank detection: a widget with 0 SVG children is blank; threshold >= 3 is a reasonable starting point for non-trivial gg2d3 plots. The existing .browser_visual_selector_count and eval_js_value already provide the infrastructure; the new test extends the JSON schema to include widget-level SVG child counts.
